gauges.name: Initial jobless claims
gauges.read: -10% vs 6 months ago. A sustained 20%+ rise has preceded recessions.

gauges.name: 10y real yield (TIPS)
gauges.read: Rising real yields pressure growth stocks and gold; falling real yields help them.

gauges.name: CPI inflation (YoY)
gauges.read: Accelerating. Hot inflation favors energy, materials, TIPS, commodities; cooling favors bonds and growth.

gauges.name: Consumer sentiment (UMich)
gauges.read: Sentiment near historic lows — a contrarian positive; stocks have averaged strong 12m returns from sentiment troughs.

gauges.name: Financial conditions (Chicago Fed)
gauges.read: Positive = tighter than average (headwind); negative = loose (tailwind).

gauges.name: M2 money supply (YoY)
gauges.read: Liquidity growth; contraction is a headwind for risk assets.

gauges.name: Housing permits
gauges.read: -3% YoY. A leading indicator for the economy and homebuilders.

gauges.name: Trade-weighted US dollar
gauges.read: +3.3% over 6 months. A falling dollar favors international/EM stocks, materials and gold.

gauges.name: Buffett indicator (market cap / GDP)
gauges.read: Higher than 100% of readings since 2010. High = broad US equities expensive; long-run returns tend to be lower.
